docs.summary: Composite filter that chains multiple IBroadPhaseFilter instances together. All filters must return true for the collision to be allowed. Filters are evaluated in the order they were added.

docs.summary: Filters the collision by running all registered filters. Returns true only if all filters return true. If any filter returns false, processing stops immediately (short-circuit evaluation).
